crossRefs.note: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.
He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.
Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,

translations.web: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.
translations.bsb: Now no one can gaze at the sun when it is bright in the skies after the wind has swept them clean.
translations.kjv: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth
translations.asv: And now men see not the light which is bright in the skies; But the wind passeth, and cleareth them.
